browser.environment: Chrome on current workstation; local HTTP server; existing normal viewport; room visible; bone arms-up; live signal 4000 counts/s; 0.75 s persistence; matrix 256
browser.method: Manual UI observations from the existing 1.5-second render counter, same tab with simple/Symbia toggles. Not a controlled GPU benchmark or a statistical performance claim.
browser.limitations: Active scan observations are at different longitudinal positions. CPU numbers cover the scene render call, not total acquisition work or GPU time. Both versions slow during sequential acquisition; no new reduction was evident from these observations.
checks: Three-dimensional and lateral views render correctly
Switch to simple and back without resetting acquisition or redownloading geometry
Rotation from 0 to 30 degrees and independent detector 1 radial motion
Whole-body start from 30 degrees rotates to 0 before accumulating counts
Automatic radial approach, table translation and both images accumulate during scan
